if (!/^T\d{4}(\.\d{3})?$/.test(technique)) return fail('invalid technique: ' + d.technique.slice(0, 40));
// ATT&CK Enterprise allowlist (embedded snapshot, see ATT.v): current + Windows only.
if (ATT.dead[technique] !== undefined) return fail(`${technique} is revoked/deprecated in ATT&CK v${ATT.v}` + (ATT.dead[technique] ? `; use ${ATT.dead[technique]} instead` : ''));
if (ATT.other[technique]) return fail(`${technique} does not apply to Windows (platforms: ${ATT.other[technique]})`);
if (!ATT.win[technique]) return fail(`${technique} is not a current ATT&CK Enterprise technique ID`);
const official = ATT.win[technique];
const STOP = new Set(['and','or','the','of','for','via','with','from','to','in','on','by','a','an','modify','other']);
const words = s => new Set(String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]+/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 2 && !STOP.has(w)));
const claimed = String(d.technique_name || '').trim();
if (!claimed) return fail('missing field: technique_name');
const ow = words(official);
if (![...words(claimed)].some(w => ow.has(w) || [...ow].some(o => o.startsWith(w.slice(0, 5)) && w.length >= 5)))
  return fail(`technique_name "${claimed.slice(0, 60)}" does not match ${technique} (${official})`);
const y = d.sigma_yaml.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').trim() + '\n';
if (/\t/.test(y)) return fail('sigma_yaml contains tab characters');
for (const k of ['title', 'logsource', 'detection', 'condition']) {
  if (!new RegExp('^\\s*' + k + ':', 'm').test(y)) return fail('sigma_yaml missing ' + k + ':');
}
if (/^\s*correlation:/m.test(y) || /^---\s*$/m.test(y)) return fail('sigma_yaml must be a single non-correlation document');
const badItem = y.split('\n').find(l => /^\s*-[^\s-]/.test(l));
if (badItem) return fail('sigma_yaml malformed list item: ' + badItem.trim().slice(0, 60));
const covered = $('Assemble context').first().json.covered || [];
if (covered.includes(technique)) return fail('duplicate: ' + technique + ' is already covered or has an open proposal');
const title = d.title.trim().slice(0, 200);
const slug = title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_|_$/g, '').slice(0, 50) || 'rule';
const t = technique.toLowerCase();
const now = new Date(), p = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const stamp = `${now.getUTCFullYear()}${p(now.getUTCMonth() + 1)}${p(now.getUTCDate())}-${p(now.getUTCHours())}${p(now.getUTCMinutes())}`;
// Unique branch (random suffix, two runs in one minute cannot collide) and a file name that cannot overwrite an existing rule.
const rand = Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 6).padEnd(4, '0');
let fname = `${t.replace('.', '_')}_${slug}.yml`;
const existingRules = (($('Assemble context').first().json.context || {}).existing_rules) || [];
if (existingRules.includes(fname)) fname = fname.replace(/\.yml$/, `_${stamp}.yml`);
return { json: {
  ok: true, technique, technique_name: official, title, llm_content: content.slice(0, 8000),
  gap_analysis: d.gap_analysis.trim(), reasoning: d.reasoning.trim().slice(0, 4000), sigma_yaml: y,
  branch: `ai-proposal/${t.replace('.', '-')}-${stamp}-${rand}`,
  path: `detections/sigma/${fname}`,
  content_b64: Buffer.from(y, 'utf8').toString('base64'),
} };
